name: Doing More with Less
title: Doing More with Less: A Survey on Routing Strategies for Resource Optimisation in Large Language Model-Based Systems
publication: arXiv version; venue not independently verified
why_read: Frames routing as resource-aware model selection and organizes similarity, supervised, reinforcement-learning, and generative approaches.
reading_question: Which objectives and generation-time information does each family assume?
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: Dynamic Model Routing and Cascading
title: Dynamic Model Routing and Cascading for Efficient LLM Inference: A Survey
publication: TMLR 2026 (author-reported acceptance)
why_read: Provides a useful design space: when a decision happens, what it observes, and how it is computed; includes evaluation failure modes.
reading_question: Does an apparent improvement survive differences in model pools, cost definitions, and evaluation protocols?
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: FrugalGPT
title: FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance
publication: arXiv version; venue not independently verified
why_read: A foundational model-cascade approach: decide when an answer is sufficient and when another model is worth its cost.
reading_question: Account for earlier calls and the answer scorer; escalation is not free.
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: RouteLLM
title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data
publication: ICLR 2025
why_read: Learns strong-versus-weak model routing from preference data; a clear entry point into routing supervision and transfer.
reading_question: Does preference-based single-query selection remain appropriate when intermediate outputs affect later steps?
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: GraphRouter
title: GraphRouter: A Graph-based Router for LLM Selections
publication: arXiv version; venue not independently verified
why_read: Represents tasks, queries, and models in a heterogeneous graph, supporting inductive model selection.
reading_question: What observations are required to introduce a new model? Query-level induction alone does not establish trajectory-level transfer.
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: BAAR
title: Budget-Aware Agentic Routing via Boundary-Guided Training
publication: arXiv version; venue not independently verified
why_read: Studies step-wise small/large model selection with path dependence, sparse terminal rewards, and explicit task budgets.
reading_question: Separate soft cost penalties from hard inference budgets, and inspect the two-model setting.
review_depth: Metadata and abstract; selected method sections, not reproduced

name: MTRouter
title: MTRouter: Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing with History-Model Joint Embeddings

why_read: Jointly embeds interaction history and candidate models, learning outcome estimates from logged multi-turn trajectories.

name: DialRouter

why_read: Uses dialogue-tree search to learn routing with long-horizon awareness and retrieval-based future-state approximation.
